title: Implement Kit Vcs Postgres Schema
description: Implement the shared PostgreSQL schema changes for semio kit version-control and normalized metabolism snapshot persistence. Extend repo/postgres/schema.sql with kit, checkpoint, alternative, session, draft, transaction, release, snapshot, and normalized snapshot entity tables aligned with the Rust KitStore VCS model and the metabolism.kit.semio.json fixture. Update repo/postgres/README.md to document the new schema groups and design boundary. Extend an existing test file to assert the schema includes the new tables and key constraints. Do not create new test files.
